**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

The document contains no most-favoured-nation provision in either direction. I checked "most favored", "no less favorable", "more favorable", "favourable", "terms offered to any other", and "match" — the only "pricing" reference (p0692) is an unrelated Treasury Rate / reference-dealer mechanic in the Exhibit A note terms. Since this Transfer and Servicing Agreement imposes no obligation on the Issuer or Depositor to give Cellco terms no less favourable than those extended to third parties, the document sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN burdening our side), and nothing needs to be added or struck.
